rules: Keep each donor site's visual structure and functional interactions intact.
Remove donor branding and route consequential product actions to the canonical Titan Zero application.
Use company_id as the canonical tenant boundary.
Marketing sites never become a runtime dependency of Titan Zero Base App.
Standalone marketing apps remain separate surfaces but share Titan Zero destination contracts.
Do not carry donor pricing, testimonials, savings figures, feature counts, trial claims, or named integration claims into Titan Zero unless verified against the canonical product.

sitePolicy.marketing-nexjob: Field Services / broad field-service industry pack
sitePolicy.marketing-fieldops: Asset Services / automotive is the initial industry pack; broaden the vertical entry point to assets, equipment, devices, appliances and vehicles
sitePolicy.marketing-trydrafted: Personal Services / initial donor conversion; do not retain contractor-only positioning

crossVerticalCapabilities: Existing-system integration plus software gap filling
Private and local LLMs and private RAG

sharedPageSystem.strategy: Each vertical site is the entry point for that vertical and may be deployed on its own subdomain. Preserve useful donor sales pages, rebrand/correct them, and add the shared Titan Zero differentiation pages rather than deleting the original site breadth.

requiredPages.purpose: Explain assessment, integration, gap-filling software, workforce configuration, ongoing management and improvement.
Privacy-first/device-first architecture, private LLM/RAG, edge node network, locality and provider choice.
BYO API/AI keys, local/private models, customer-owned compute and transparent third-party cost structure.
Environmental assessment, auditing, evidence, compliance and improvement with appropriately qualified environmental scientists where professional judgement/sign-off is required.
Explain how the Titan Zero managed-system model differs from typical software-first and bundled-AI approaches without unsupported competitor claims.
Vertical-specific industry directory linking to dedicated industry landing pages.

sharedPageSystem.deployment: Vertical entry sites must remain independently deployable so DNS/subdomains can be assigned later without making them Titan Zero runtime dependencies.
sharedPageSystem.copyRule: Reuse the shared page architecture and concepts across verticals, but rewrite examples, workflows, pain points, workforce roles, capabilities and industry language for the target vertical.
sharedPageSystem.industryPageRule: Each listed industry should have a dedicated landing page beneath its vertical entry site. Industry pages should use the vertical's shared managed-system architecture but contain industry-specific workflows, pain points, workforce roles, knowledge and capabilities.
